_comment: Copy this file to cards.config.json and edit locally. Key = LAST 5 DIGITS of the card number. name = display name. mmdd = statement-cycle date (MM=month used as accumulation-cycle anchor, DD=closing day). Optional reserved key _default.mmdd = fallback applied automatically to any newly-detected card that has no mmdd yet (e.g. '1231' = year-end); existing entries are never overwritten. cards.config.json is git-ignored so real card numbers never reach the repo. You can also set entries with the /set-expiryCard command, and list every card with /list-cards.
